_comment: Reviewed pairings from this page's foods to Frida 6.1 rows, by FoodID.
Empty on purpose. This file held 17 slug-to-id pairs written in August 2026
with no state, no grade and no review, predating the discipline
BIOTIN-MAP-REVIEW.md set. Nothing read them and no Frida value has ever
reached the page, so they were quoted into FRIDA-MAP-REVIEW.md above the
food each was for and taken out of here, rather than carried across a change
of standard. A pairing nobody checked is not evidence that it is right.
The shape, once a pairing is banked:
`name` is the row's own, carried so that a FoodID pointing somewhere else
after a release is visible rather than silent. `match` is exact, close or
proxy. `reviewed` must be true: the pass that reads this file will refuse an
entry without it, the way tools/flavonoids.mjs refuses an unreviewed
Candidates are in FRIDA-MAP-REVIEW.md and proposed-page-map-frida.json,
written by `node tools/frida.mjs propose`. A tool may propose a pairing and
only a human may bank one.
